svg.title: Single-cell multiomics regulatory network inference
svg.desc: Independent TF–gene, TF–region and region–gene fits. Exact genomic-region matching produces region-resolved networks for fetal-cortex examples, with direct TF–gene overlap assessed separately; direct TF–gene associations and RNA profiles describe contrasting HMGA1 and SOX6 erythroid programs.
